descriptions.inProgress: I went to go see #p2140001# just as #p2140000# told me to.  He immediately knew that I lost my memory and said in order to retrieve the lost memory, I would need to go back to the beginning where my adventure began...
descriptions.completed: After talking to the Memory Keeper, I went to my previous job post at Victoria Island to retrieve my memory.  I wonder if I got my memory back?  I guess I'll know when I try to go past Memory Lane...
